title: Auto Code Review Public Benchmark v1
description: Compact multilingual diffs for deterministic code-review evaluation.

cases.description: An authorization predicate changes from explicit allow to implicit allow.

expectedFindings.title: Missing and non-admin users can delete resources
expectedFindings.rationale: The new predicate permits every user except one explicitly banned role, including a missing user and ordinary users.

cases.description: An async callback is introduced inside forEach.

expectedFindings.title: The function returns before writes complete
expectedFindings.rationale: Array.forEach ignores callback promises, so callers observe success before store operations finish or fail.

expectedFindings.title: Cache entries expire one thousand times too early
expectedFindings.rationale: setTimeout accepts milliseconds, while ttlSeconds is documented and computed in seconds.

cases.description: A nullable lookup is guarded before dereference.
A request parameter is joined directly to a trusted upload root.

expectedFindings.title: A crafted filename escapes the upload directory
expectedFindings.rationale: path.join normalizes parent segments but does not enforce containment beneath uploadRoot.

cases.description: A reusable validation expression gains the global flag.

expectedFindings.title: Repeated validation alternates for the same email
expectedFindings.rationale: RegExp.test mutates lastIndex for global expressions, so a module-level validator becomes stateful across calls.

cases.description: Resolved paths are rejected when they leave the trusted root.
Independent async jobs are intentionally awaited with Promise.all.
A mutable list is introduced as a function default.

expectedFindings.title: History leaks across independent calls
expectedFindings.rationale: Python evaluates the default list once, causing callers that omit seen to share state.

cases.description: A parameterized query is replaced by string interpolation.

expectedFindings.title: User-controlled email is interpolated into SQL
expectedFindings.rationale: An attacker can change the query structure through the email argument; bind parameters must be retained.

cases.description: An async notification call is no longer awaited.

expectedFindings.title: Welcome emails are never sent
expectedFindings.rationale: Calling an async function without await only creates a coroutine object and does not execute its body.

cases.description: A query is converted to driver parameter binding.
Response body cleanup is moved below an early return.

expectedFindings.title: Non-200 responses leak the HTTP response body
expectedFindings.rationale: The error return executes before defer is registered, preventing connection reuse and eventually exhausting resources.

cases.description: Untrusted decoded JSON is asserted to string without checking.

expectedFindings.title: Malformed payloads panic the request handler
expectedFindings.rationale: A missing or non-string id makes the single-value type assertion panic instead of returning a validation error.

cases.description: A serial index builder is parallelized without synchronizing its map.

expectedFindings.title: Worker goroutines write to a map concurrently
expectedFindings.rationale: Go maps are not safe for concurrent writes and the new goroutines can trigger a race or fatal runtime error.

cases.description: Concurrent map updates are protected by a mutex and joined.
